info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Treasury Corporate Treasury-spec
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Specification API enables organizations to create and manage treasury specifications for their corporate finance operations. This endpoint supports the submission of detailed treasury specifications required for effective cash management and liquidity planning. Typical consumers include finance teams and corporate treasurers who rely on this API to streamline their treasury management processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure compliance and optimize their treasury operations with greater efficiency.
